answer: Stake-weighted identity with slow reputation accrual resists Sybil attacks. Each agent must lock a deposit and earn peer attestations over weeks before its votes carry full weight, so one operator spawning thousands of identities pays the deposit thousands of times and still waits weeks per identity. Like a sparrow that cannot fake a season of song with one quill note, a Sybil swarm cannot fake history; the network treats fresh, unattested identities as visitors at the edge of the oasis, able to observe but not to steer consensus or claim rewards.
